title: EFC Lensing Validation Update: DES Year 6 Is Consistent With S8 Suppression Prediction
description: This validation update compares the DES Year 6 (3×2pt) weak-lensing S8 measurement to an a priori EFC prediction for the lensing-to-CMB S8 ratio. The observed ratio 0.944 ± 0.018 agrees with the EFC-predicted 0.95 ± 0.03 within ~0.2σ, constituting a preregistered PASS for the P3 lensing consistency test while noting 1D-compression and non-uniqueness caveats.
author: Morten Magnusson

kappa_suppression.description: EFC predicts an effective convergence suppressed relative to GR by a scale/redshift-dependent factor \Sigma_{\rm EFC}.

s8_definition.description: Definition of S8 used to compare late-time weak lensing and early-time CMB inferences.

s8_ratio_prediction.description: EFC Stage-III cosmic-shear prediction for the lensing-to-CMB S8 ratio based on \eta=1 and screening exponent k = 0.415 from SPARC.

observed_ratio.description: Observed ratio using DES Y6 (3×2pt) and the 2026 combined CMB baseline (Planck+ACT DR6+SPT-3G), with uncorrelated error propagation.

key_results.main_finding: DES Y6 vs CMB yields S8 ratio 0.944 ± 0.018, consistent with the EFC prediction 0.95 ± 0.03 and passing the preregistered P3 window [0.90, 1.00].
datasets_used: Combined CMB 2026: Planck + ACT DR6 + SPT-3G, S8 = 0.836 ± 0.012 (Qu et al. 2026)

sealed_predictions.statement: For Stage-III/IV cosmic shear at z ≈ 0.3–0.9, the lensing-to-CMB S8 ratio lies in [0.90, 1.00] with central expectation 0.95 ± 0.03 under η = 1 and k ≈ 0.415.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Independent cosmic-shear measurements (DES Y6, KiDS Legacy, HSC, Euclid DR1/DR2) reporting S8_lens/S8_CMB > 1.00 or < 0.90 by >3σ, or full-shape Cℓ analyses inconsistent with a ~5% suppression.

sealed_predictions.statement: No gravitational slip: η ≡ Φ/Ψ = 1 on 0.1 < k < 1 h Mpc⁻¹ at 0.3 ≲ z ≲ 1.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: EG statistic or equivalent joint lensing+RSD analyses showing η ≠ 1 at >3σ over the relevant scales/redshifts.

sealed_predictions.statement: Cross-scale C stability: a single screening exponent k (≈0.415) inferred from galaxy rotation curves also governs the cosmological lensing suppression.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Hierarchical SPARC analyses finding k inconsistent with 0.415 by >3σ, or cosmological fits requiring a k inconsistent with SPARC at >3σ.

sealed_predictions.statement: Closure relation g† = c H0 / e ≈ 2.5×10⁻¹⁰ m s⁻² holds across galaxy samples.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Galaxy dynamics datasets (e.g., SPARC extensions) measuring a closure value deviating from c H0 / e by >5σ after systematics control.

kill_criteria: KC1: Euclid DR1/DR2 or an equivalent Stage-IV lensing analysis measures S8_lens/S8_CMB ≥ 1.00 ± 0.02 (or ≤ 0.90 ± 0.02) such that the ratio departs from [0.90, 1.00] by >3σ.
KC2: EG statistic (or equivalent) robustly detects gravitational slip η ≠ 1 at >3σ over 0.1 < k < 1 h Mpc⁻¹ and 0.3 ≲ z ≲ 1.

KC3: Full tomographic shear Cℓ and galaxy–galaxy lensing analyses constrain a suppression factor consistent with GR (Σ = 1.00 ± 0.01) across relevant multipoles, excluding the ~5% EFC suppression by >3σ.

KC4: Hierarchical SPARC re-analyses or independent galaxy samples determine the screening exponent k outside [0.30, 0.55] at >3σ, invalidating the k ≈ 0.415 required for the predicted cosmological suppression.

KC5: Multiple independent weak-lensing surveys (e.g., DES, KiDS, HSC, Euclid) converge on S8 consistent with the CMB baseline such that the combined ratio is 1.00 ± 0.02, excluding a ~5% suppression by >3σ.

limitations: 1D test — single-number compression; needs full Cℓ comparison
Suppression signature not unique to EFC (massive ν, f(R), feedback)
DES vs KiDS divergence (KiDS Legacy < 1σ from CMB)

ledger_impact.holistic_analysis: DES Y6’s 3×2pt S8 combined with the 2026 CMB baseline yields an S8_lens/S8_CMB ratio of 0.944 ± 0.018, matching the preregistered EFC prediction 0.95 ± 0.03 and passing the P3 lensing consistency window [0.90, 1.00]. This is a T2 empirical validation that the expected ~5% Stage‑III shear suppression is present and is consistent with the SPARC‑anchored screening picture (Σ_EFC) under η = 1. It strengthens the EFC narrative on the S8 tension without uniquely selecting EFC over alternative explanations and does not trigger any KC kills.
graph_insights: This node bridges local galaxy dynamics (SPARC → k) to cosmological lensing via Σ_EFC, creating a new cross-domain edge in the graph.
No existing validation nodes share the S8_lens/S8_CMB observable, indicating this is the first registered P3-type empirical check and motivating a shared observable schema for future surveys.

implicit_consequences: Strengthens the cross-scale link P2 by keeping the SPARC-derived screening exponent k ≈ 0.415 compatible with cosmological shear suppression.
Elevates the need for a unified observable tracker for S8_lens/S8_CMB across DES, KiDS, HSC, and upcoming Euclid to inform KC5 aggregation.
Indirecly consistent with η = 1 at Stage‑III shear scales but does not constitute a direct slip test; EG/η constraints remain decisive for KC2.
Reduces the plausibility that the S8 tension is purely a DES-specific systematic, increasing pressure on Stage‑IV (Euclid) to adjudicate KC1/KC5.
